Independent finite graph-map enumerator constructed local adjacency maps and induced colour-isomorphism targets for all 32,583 words on m=3..11 (3 colours to m=9, then 2 colours to m=11); every case matched the theorem.

correctness.rationale: The actual final RESULT.md proof establishes every connected irreflexive locally-surjective quotient of C_m has maximum degree 2, hence is P_l (l≥2) or C_d (d≥3). For cycle targets, back-surjectivity forces a consistent forward/backward covering f(i)=a±i mod d, giving d|m and the named colour word factoring iff p|d. For path targets, each interior image must traverse the two distinct neighbours and each endpoint must reverse direction, forcing the reflection walk rho_L(i+t) of exact period L=2(l−1). Closing requires even L|m; fibre colour compatibility requires p|L and a vertex-centred reflection. Two reflections compose to translation 2(s−t), yielding one centre class modulo odd p and two for even p. Target reversal shifts centre by L/2, swapping these classes precisely when L/p is odd; for even L/p they are distinct because equality would force forbidden period p/2. This gives the exact q_L and divisor sums. Cases m=3, l=2, constant p=1, odd m, p even and long multipliers were explicitly covered.
residual_risks: The independent finite enumerator does not prove all lengths/alphabets; the all-parameter conclusion rests on the written normal-form and group-action proof.
Changing irreflexivity, undirectedness or back-surjectivity would change the normal forms; the theorem does not extend to those settings.

RESULT.md complete classification and symbolic reflection argument.
value.rationale: A complete, exact isomorphism-type spectrum for one natural class of coloured Kripke/role frames is a motivated classification: it yields the least possible folded quotient and the complete divisor-count law, and shows a genuine parity phenomenon not supplied by a generic yes/no homomorphism algorithm. A researcher studying modal abstraction or finite role reductions could require precisely which nonisomorphic colour targets survive; not just whether a map exists. The proof is elementary but not a routine renaming or a computation of arbitrary small instances.
residual_risks: The result is specific to connected simple irreflexive images of a cycle and named colour-preserving quotients; wider implications are not established.
No claim is made that this is a major general modal-logic theorem or a minimal description-length result.

final_claim: For m>=3, with named cyclic vertex-colouring w of primitive period p|m, all connected irreflexive undirected simple bounded-morphic quotient targets are coloured cycles C_d for d|m, d>=3, p|d (one isomorphism class each), or coloured paths P_(1+L/2) if and only if m is even, w has a vertex-axis reflection, L|m is even and p|L. Each such path order has q_L=2 precisely when p and L/p are both even, and q_L=1 otherwise. Minimal path order is 1+lcm(p,2)/2. Total paths are tau(m/(2p)) for p odd with m even, or tau(m/p)+1_{2|m/p}tau(m/(2p)) for even p and reflection.
